text: Generate the code from the approved design.

I wrote `src/app/app.ts`, `src/app/main.ts` and `public/index.html`. Typecheck and drift detection both come back clean.

- **Database:** The design has no database node, so `createApp()` takes no parameter. The two repositories still need a `DatabaseSync`, so it opens an in-memory one itself. Data is lost on every restart. If you want a file-backed database, the design needs a database node first.
- **Routes:** There is one route per controller method under `/api`, plus `GET /health` registered before the others. Admin routes read the token from the `x-admin-token` header.
- **Error handling:** An error whose message ends with "not found" returns 404. Every other thrown error returns 400.
- **Page:** The page uses `fetch` and shows data with `textContent`. It covers saving your identity, checking availability and booking, listing, cancelling and changing your bookings, viewing a room's schedule, and admin login with room management.
- **Class fix:** `RoomService.addRoom` generated its own string room id, but `RoomRepository.save` treats any non-empty id as an update. Every room creation failed with "not found". It now passes an empty id so the repository assigns one.
- **Admin password:** `AdminAuthService` reads `ADMIN_PASSWORD` and rejects every login if it is unset, so set it before starting the server.

I did not start the server or call the routes, so none of this has been run.

Bookings must survive a restart. SQLite runs inside the app process (see the Persistence component on the Application Server node), so open a file database at the path in DB_PATH, default ./data/booking.db, creating the folder if needed. Keep :memory: only when DB_PATH is ':memory:' so tests can use it.

`createApp()` in `src/app/app.ts` now opens a file database, so bookings survive a restart. Typecheck is clean. I didn't run detect_drift because I touched no class file. I also didn't start the server or restart it to confirm the data persists.

- **Path:** it reads `DB_PATH` and defaults to `./data/booking.db`. It creates the folder first if it is missing.
- **Tests:** when `DB_PATH` is `:memory:`, it skips folder creation and uses an in-memory database.
- **Signature:** `createApp` still takes no parameter. The design has only the two nodes User Browser and Application Server, with no node of kind database, so `createApp` resolves the path itself. If you want to pass a `DatabaseSync` from outside, the design needs a database node first.
- **`main.ts`:** I left it unchanged.

Typecheck and detect_drift are both clean. I haven't started the server or run any routes.

- **Removed classes:** I deleted `src/web-frontend/IdentityStore.ts` and `src/web-frontend/WebClient.ts`, the files for DSN-014 and DSN-015. Nothing else imported them.
- **Web Frontend (DSN-016):** `public/index.html` now has `<!-- @trace DSN-016 REQ-006 REQ-008 -->` as the first line in `<head>`. The rest of the page is unchanged.
- **Database:** The two repositories take `db`, so `createApp` is now `createApp(db?: DatabaseSync)` and defaults to an in-memory database. `main.ts` opens `process.env.DB_PATH ?? './data/booking.db'`. It creates the folder first unless the path is `:memory:`. It passes the database to `createApp`.
- **Behaviour change:** `createApp()` no longer opens the file database itself. Calling it with no argument gives an in-memory database, which suits tests. The server entry point gives you the persistent file.
- **Unchanged:** I touched no class files and made no route changes.

The code now matches the new design, and `detect_drift` is clean. `start_app` is ok. `typecheck` still fails with two errors, both in test files that I can't edit.

- **`BookingRuleChecker` (new, DSN-024):** it's in `src/domain-services/BookingRuleChecker.ts`. `check` runs the time slot validation, then rejects overlaps with non-cancelled bookings of the same room. It ignores the booking named in `excludeId`.
- **`BookingService` (DSN-007):** the constructor now takes `BookingRuleChecker`, `RoomRepository` and `BookingRepository`, as in the shape you gave. `create` and `changeTime` call `check` and no longer validate the slot or look for overlaps themselves. The ownership, started-booking, room-active and atomic-insert rules are unchanged.
- **`src/app/app.ts`:** it creates one `BookingRuleChecker` from the existing `TimeSlotPolicy` and `BookingRepository`, and passes it to `BookingService`. Routes didn't change, and `main.ts` and `public/index.html` needed no edit.
- **Domain Services (DSN-018):** I made no change for this component, apart from the files above.

**Failing typecheck:** `test/UC-002.test.ts` (line 86) and `test/UC-009.test.ts` (line 27) still build `BookingService` with a `TimeSlotPolicy` as its first argument. They need to build a `BookingRuleChecker` from a `TimeSlotPolicy` and the booking repository, and pass that instead.
